claims.statement: Validated stiff integration, taken as stated and at the depth read: Nedialkov-Jackson overview of validated interval-Taylor / Hermite-Obreschkoff methods (wrapping effect as a stability question; truncation-error formulae make validated stiff methods hard), read at snippet/abstract level; Neumaier's logarithmic-norm enclosures (arnold-neumaier.at/ms/ode.pdf, ivpBounds.pdf), secondary; Sandretto-Chapoutot DynIBEX validated Runge-Kutta incl. implicit Radau, arXiv:1804.04847, abstract read; arXiv:2604.19068 (Taylor tube method) listed by search, not read. VNODE-LP, CAPD, COSY, Ariadne, Flow*, VSPODE papers were not individually checked.

Textbook and documentation statement, taken as stated: BDF/CVODE error control is local, there is no global error guarantee, and the global error need not be proportional to the tolerance (Hairer-Wanner II Sec. IV.8; SUNDIALS documentation).
Reference solutions of the Bari stiff test set for Robertson were computed with RADAU in double precision at tight tolerance and are not validated (secondary reports).

Step theorem. For a quadratic planar field f, a polynomial reference q, an invertible P, defect bound dbar >= sup ||P^-1 (f(q)-q')||, a box U containing every segment [q(t), q(t)+Pw] with |w| <= rho, and nu >= sup_U lambda_max(sym(P^-1 J P)): if (eps0 + dbar h) exp(max(nu,0) h) < rho then the solution exists on [0,h] and ||z-q||_P <= eps0 e^{nu t} + dbar int_0^t e^{nu s} ds. Proof by the first-exit argument and f(z)-f(q) = J(q+e/2) e, exact because J is affine; the defect is an exact polynomial (no remainder). The code (ph2_enclose.py, lines 77-88, 98-113, 187-255) implements the obligations; the auditor read each obligation (defect, one-sided Lipschitz, bootstrap, jump and basis change, output, rounding, resume) and judged them discharged. The proof is in prose, not formalised.

Controls. Positive: the stiff linear system (exact solution known in balls) and the logistic equation are contained at all tested times at p=24 and p=6. Negative: with the defect term dropped (p=6) containment is lost at every time for both systems. The (1+1e-6) shift is rejected for the linear y1 and both logistic components at p=24 but never for the linear y2 (relative width ~3e7): adjudicated as a test without power, not a soundness failure. controls.json was produced by an earlier code version; the auditor's rerun on the final code gives the same verdicts.

Enclosure. Under the assumptions that Arb (Sage 9.5) ball arithmetic is correct and the step theorem holds, the solution of Robertson's problem (k=1/25, 1e4, 3e7; y(0)=(1,0,0)) lies in the exact-rational boxes of enclosures.json at t = 0.1, 0.4, 1, 4, 10, 40, 100, 400, 1000, 4000, with relative width <= 1e-6 required and <= 5.99e-10 reported (y2 at t=4000); 2,850,083 steps, 8.31 core-hours, stopped on the CPU cap (outcome PARTIAL; T=40000 not reached). Independently confirmed at t = 1, 10, 40 only (PH2-C-0004).

Independent re-derivation at t = 1, 10, 40. The auditor's Lohner interval Taylor integrator (MPFI, 128 bits, order 18, no logarithmic norm, no producer step logic) produced boxes lying inside the producer's boxes on all three components at t=1, 10 and 40 (midpoints agree to about 1e-26 to 1e-30; auditor radii 1e3 to 1e8 times narrower; at t=10 y2 the producer's midpoint lies outside the auditor's narrower box, consistent with inclusion). No box was compared at t = 0.1, 0.4, 4.

True global error of the rusty-SUNDIALS cvode crate (a Rust port of CVODE, NOT C CVODE; HEAD af4886f2, BDF, Newton, dense LU, analytic Jacobian, scalar atol) against the enclosure: 120 error intervals (4 rtol x 10 output times x 3 components), by exact ball subtraction of the solver's doubles from the boxes. rtol 1e-4, 1e-6, 1e-8 use atol = 1e-3 rtol; rtol 1e-10 uses atol = 1e-10 (non-preregistered; the preregistered atol 1e-13 run failed with ErrTestFailure). Largest error over the ten times in units of rtol*|y| for (y1,y2,y3): 2.7, 4.1, 2.2 (1e-4); 8.1, 10.9, 8.2 (1e-6); 16.6, 20.3, 13.8 (1e-8); 136, 169, 486 (1e-10).

For y2 the preregistered 'provably exceeds tolerance' flag is never raised only because the tolerance for y2 (<= 3.6e-5) is atol-dominated (largest error / atol = 0.16); against rtol*|y2| alone the port's error is up to 4.1x (1e-4), 11x (1e-6), 20x (1e-8), 169x (1e-10, t=4000) the relative tolerance. The flag compares a global error with a local-error tolerance scale; it documents the global error and is not a breach of the solver's contract. For this port, these settings and this problem only.

HEADLINE. A validated enclosure of Robertson's problem at ten output times from 0.1 to 4000 (relative width <= 1e-6 required, <= 6e-10 reported), rigorous under the stated assumptions (Arb correct; log-norm step theorem proved in prose, not formalised), independently re-derived by a different method at t = 1, 10, 40 only; and the true error of a Rust port of CVODE (not C CVODE) for rtol 1e-4..1e-10 against it, including the atol-dominance finding for y2. Producer and one independent audit are AI agents; no human audit; the preregistration was first committed after the run started (mtimes and self-hash only); no Lean.

NOT independently confirmed: the enclosure for 40 < t <= 4000. The auditor's integrator reached t=40 only; the non-rigorous double-precision Radau cross-check at t=4000 agrees to ~1e-14 relative but lies OUTSIDE the producer's y1 and y3 boxes (offset ~8e-15 against radius ~5e-16, within the Radau runs' own spread) and cannot test the box. Single implementation plus code audit only.

NOT established: the provenance of the Rust binary (Cargo path dependency; HEAD af4886f2 recorded, not pinned); the correctness of Arb/Sage 9.5 beyond the MPFI cross-check to t=40; the step theorem is not formalised (no Lean). 'Formally verified' is NOT claimed. NOT a statement about LLNL C CVODE, general stiff problems, or t >= 1e4.

The cvRoberts_dns values (t = 0.4, 4, 40, five digits) in RESULT.md were recalled, not fetched, and are SOLVER OUTPUT at rtol=1e-4 with vector atol, not the true solution; no conclusion is drawn from them.

Novelty is NOT a certified fact: 'to our knowledge' no validated Robertson enclosure to t >= 4000 and no CVODE-versus-enclosure study was found, in a limited search (2 web + 2 alphaXiv queries at scouting, repeated at audit); VNODE-LP, CAPD, COSY, Ariadne papers not individually checked; authors not contacted; no priority claim. Also unverifiable from version control: the preregistration freeze (PREREG_ITEM.md first committed 2026-11-13, after the 2026-11-11 launch; mtimes and a self-hash only).
